displayName: Azure AI virtual network rules should use approved subnets
description: Audit or deny Cognitive Services accounts with configured VNet rules outside approved subnet resource IDs, including dormant rules while public access is disabled. Does not require a VNet rule when IP rules or private endpoints are used. Checks rule configuration, not subnet existence, service endpoints, or Foundry VNet injection. Audit is the default.

metadata.description: Audit reports noncompliance by default. Deny blocks noncompliant create or update requests when explicitly selected.

metadata.displayName: Approved Cognitive Services subnet resource IDs
metadata.description: Supply full subnet resource IDs, not just VNet IDs or names. Empty approves no configured VNet rules. Search and ML workspaces do not use this Cognitive Services subnet-rule property.
